label: Predictable amnesia defeats unrestricted future deference
paraphrase: In the same fair two-coin-world model, a world-revealing present report gives Heads conditional one or zero; a later erased report gives one half in both worlds. Conditioning now on both present knowledge and that known future one-half report preserves one or zero, while conditioning on the future report alone yields one half. The erased report cannot reconstruct the revealing report; the reverse reconstruction exists. Thus unrestricted future-credence deference fails in this explicit loss-of-information control even with each credence calculated by ordinary report conditioning. No claim of Beauty applicability follows.
